changes: Expose planParquetTaskWorkUnitsOwned returning OwnedMemory<TaskInput[]> and route the plain API through it.
Keep metadata in a separate child scope and release it before transferring the planned task owner.
Returned task arrays, descriptors and detached payloads remain charged until the last retained owner releases.

validation.fixtures: Metadata-backed and metadata-free plans each produce two work units from a real Parquet file. Live reservation equals owner bytes after return; a competing full-pool reservation fails; retain/release preserves tasks and final release returns usage to zero.

remaining: Generic aggregate-task grouping topology is not yet admitted.
The plain API intentionally transfers storage to caller ownership at return.
Borrowed-only store metadata preallocation remains external to admission.
Full current-revision gates and mixed-job scheduling/resource acceptance remain open.
